revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 15.9% (45,183 vs 39,001); fade from 13% to 8% as scale grows and subscriber growth matures.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 29.5% (13,327/45,183), up from 26.7% in FY2024 and 20.6% in FY2023; modest operating leverage to 31% held flat.

tax_rate.source: Derived from FY2025 filings: pretax 12,722.6M, net income 10,981.2M gives about 13.7% effective rate; assume 16% as moderate normalization upward. Assumption.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A 333.4/45,183 = 0.74%; slightly higher as capex grows. Note: content amortization is excluded from D&A and treated as operating cost in EBIT.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta 1.1 (my assumption, not looked up from Damodaran industry data) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 9.8% cost of equity; debt about 14.5B is small versus equity, so debt weight is low and the after-tax cost of debt is lower; blended WACC about 9.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal US GDP growth.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = (LTD noncurrent 13,463.971 + short-term borrowings 998.865) - cash 9,033.681 - ST investments 28.678; 10-K acc. 0001065280-26-000034
